answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a new approach to overgenerate and select admissible summaries... We have focused on generating abstractive summaries from single source sentences...

answer_2.quote: The system summaries are evaluated using both automatic metrics (ROUGE; ) and human evaluation of information coverage...

answer_4.quote: We recruit human evaluators to judge the quality of each summary given its source text... Our annotators are recruited using Appen...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer three yes-no questions: (a) has the summary successfully convey the main points? (b) is the summary truthful? (c) is the summary grammatical?
